    liked_songs.extend(page)

steps.code:
# Loop: while current song is not liked, go to next song
current_song_id = current['song_id']
liked_ids = {s['song_id'] for s in liked_songs}

while current_song_id not in liked_ids:
    print(f"Current song {current_song_id} not liked, skipping to next...")
    result = apis.spotify.next_song(access_token=access_token)
    print(f"Next song result: {result}")
    # After next_song, get the new current song
    current = apis.spotify.show_current_song(access_token=access_token)
    current_song_id = current['song_id']
    print(f"Now playing: {current['title']} (id={current_song_id})")

print(f"Reached liked song: {current['title']} (id={current_song_id})")
apis.supervisor.complete_task(answer=current['title'])
